usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks and PostSpread schedules social posts, so “New Complete Task” can run “Create Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Complete Task” in Todoist, then “Create Post” in PostSpread
bestTemplate.why: A finished task becomes a post to review, so shipped work gets shared.

watchOut: “Create Post” can publish now, schedule or save a draft, so choose draft until you trust the text.
